name: ReceiptBatch_get_report_rpa_data
description: Read-only complete linked receipt/report data for future RPA integration.
command:
WITH report_header AS (
    SELECT MAX(r.REPORT_ID) AS REPORT_NUMBER,
           MAX(r.REPORT_NAME) AS REPORT_PURPOSE,
           TO_CHAR(MAX(r.REPORT_CREATE_DATE), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS REPORT_CREATE_DATE,
           COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_RECEIPTS
    FROM XX_AP_BATCH_RECEIPTS r
    WHERE r.REPORT_ID = '${REPORT_NUMBER}'
),
receipt_rows AS (
    SELECT h.REPORT_NUMBER AS HEADER_REPORT_NUMBER,
           h.REPORT_PURPOSE AS HEADER_REPORT_PURPOSE,
           h.REPORT_CREATE_DATE AS HEADER_REPORT_CREATE_DATE,
           h.TOTAL_RECEIPTS AS HEADER_TOTAL_RECEIPTS,
           r.*
    FROM XX_AP_BATCH_RECEIPTS r
    CROSS JOIN report_header h
    WHERE r.REPORT_ID = '${REPORT_NUMBER}'
)
SELECT h.REPORT_NUMBER AS REPORT_NUMBER,
       h.REPORT_PURPOSE AS REPORT_PURPOSE,
       h.REPORT_CREATE_DATE AS REPORT_CREATE_DATE,
       h.TOTAL_RECEIPTS AS TOTAL_RECEIPTS,
       (SELECT NVL(JSON_ARRAYAGG(
                   JSON_OBJECT(
                       'REPORT_NUMBER' VALUE rr.HEADER_REPORT_NUMBER,
                       'REPORT_PURPOSE' VALUE rr.HEADER_REPORT_PURPOSE,
                       'REPORT_CREATE_DATE' VALUE rr.HEADER_REPORT_CREATE_DATE,
                       'RECEIPT_ID' VALUE rr.RECEIPT_ID,
                       'STATUS' VALUE rr.STATUS,
                       'EBS_USER_NAME' VALUE rr.EBS_USER_NAME,
                       'FILE_NAME' VALUE rr.FILE_NAME,
                       'FILE_TYPE' VALUE rr.FILE_TYPE,
                       'EXPENSE_TYPE' VALUE rr.EXPENSE_TYPE,
                       'TOTAL_AMOUNT' VALUE rr.TOTAL_AMOUNT,
                       'RECEIPT_DATE' VALUE TO_CHAR(rr.RECEIPT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
                       'MERCHANT' VALUE rr.MERCHANT,
                       'LOCATION' VALUE rr.LOCATION,
                       'DEPARTMENT' VALUE rr.DEPARTMENT,
                       'CREDIT_TRANSACTION' VALUE rr.CREDIT_TRANSACTION,
                       'EXPENSE_DATA_JSON' VALUE rr.EXPENSE_DATA_JSON,
                       'EXPENSE_DATA_JSON_LENGTH' VALUE DBMS_LOB.GETLENGTH(rr.EXPENSE_DATA_JSON),
                       'EXPENSE_DATA_UPDATED_DATE' VALUE TO_CHAR(rr.EXPENSE_DATA_UPDATED_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF6'),
                       'TEMPLATE_NAME' VALUE rr.TEMPLATE_NAME,
                       'PAYMENT_TYPE' VALUE rr.PAYMENT_TYPE,
                       'LINE_NUM' VALUE rr.LINE_NUM,
                       'ERROR_MESSAGE' VALUE rr.ERROR_MESSAGE,
                       'TOTAL_RECEIPTS' VALUE rr.HEADER_TOTAL_RECEIPTS
                       NULL ON NULL
                       RETURNING CLOB
                   )
                   ORDER BY rr.RECEIPT_ID
                   RETURNING CLOB
               ), TO_CLOB('[]'))
          FROM receipt_rows rr
         WHERE rr.CREDIT_TRANSACTION IS NULL
            OR NOT REGEXP_LIKE(rr.CREDIT_TRANSACTION, '[^[:space:]]')) AS "REPORT_CASH_RECEIPTS",
       (SELECT NVL(JSON_ARRAYAGG(
                   JSON_OBJECT(
                       'REPORT_NUMBER' VALUE rr.HEADER_REPORT_NUMBER,
                       'REPORT_PURPOSE' VALUE rr.HEADER_REPORT_PURPOSE,
                       'REPORT_CREATE_DATE' VALUE rr.HEADER_REPORT_CREATE_DATE,
                       'RECEIPT_ID' VALUE rr.RECEIPT_ID,
                       'STATUS' VALUE rr.STATUS,
                       'EBS_USER_NAME' VALUE rr.EBS_USER_NAME,
                       'FILE_NAME' VALUE rr.FILE_NAME,
                       'FILE_TYPE' VALUE rr.FILE_TYPE,
                       'EXPENSE_TYPE' VALUE rr.EXPENSE_TYPE,
                       'TOTAL_AMOUNT' VALUE rr.TOTAL_AMOUNT,
                       'RECEIPT_DATE' VALUE TO_CHAR(rr.RECEIPT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
                       'MERCHANT' VALUE rr.MERCHANT,
                       'LOCATION' VALUE rr.LOCATION,
                       'DEPARTMENT' VALUE rr.DEPARTMENT,
                       'CREDIT_TRANSACTION' VALUE rr.CREDIT_TRANSACTION,
                       'EXPENSE_DATA_JSON' VALUE rr.EXPENSE_DATA_JSON,
                       'EXPENSE_DATA_JSON_LENGTH' VALUE DBMS_LOB.GETLENGTH(rr.EXPENSE_DATA_JSON),
                       'EXPENSE_DATA_UPDATED_DATE' VALUE TO_CHAR(rr.EXPENSE_DATA_UPDATED_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF6'),
                       'TEMPLATE_NAME' VALUE rr.TEMPLATE_NAME,
                       'PAYMENT_TYPE' VALUE rr.PAYMENT_TYPE,
                       'LINE_NUM' VALUE rr.LINE_NUM,
                       'ERROR_MESSAGE' VALUE rr.ERROR_MESSAGE,
                       'TOTAL_RECEIPTS' VALUE rr.HEADER_TOTAL_RECEIPTS
                       NULL ON NULL
                       RETURNING CLOB
                   )
                   ORDER BY rr.RECEIPT_ID
                   RETURNING CLOB
               ), TO_CLOB('[]'))
          FROM receipt_rows rr
         WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(rr.CREDIT_TRANSACTION, '[^[:space:]]')) AS "REPORT_CREDIT_RECEIPTS"
FROM report_header h
